title: AI-USP Fiscal Thresholds: Reproduction Package for AI, Fiscal Space, and Universal Social Protection
description: Phase A reproduction package for an accounting-fiscal threshold framework evaluating whether AI-induced fiscal space can cover universal or categorical social protection costs in Peru, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico. Includes certified deterministic engine, audited calibration registry, frozen snapshot manifests, archived reference outputs, schemas, tests, and minimal methods documentation.
